Before I do anything — what specifically feels off? "Need work" could mean a bunch of different things: nobody's saying anything real in them, they go the same way every time, the takeaways don't lead to action, timing's bad, whatever. I don't want to guess and then "fix" the wrong thing.

Also worth being straight about where I actually am: I don't have a way to run a retro yet — no tool that lets me facilitate one, capture rounds, or post a synthesis. So whatever we land on, it's a plan we talk through, not something I can go execute today.

If you can give me a concrete example — a retro that went flat, or a pattern you've noticed over a few of them — I can give you a real read instead of a guess dressed up as one.
